limitations: Conservative DT_NEEDED closure of all423selectedDSOs from71distributions; no four-import reachability/dynamic-loader/runtime/renderer proof.
Standalone EXEC files outside DSO filename/type scope are excluded; full accepted package namespace is independently held unchanged by parent.
Packaged candidates preferred to exact known /usr/lib SONAME paths; recorded ORIGIN paths and candidate unions are static models, not symbol/RTLD/dlopen success.
Trusted Python prefix is separately readonly mounted; prefix ELF index seeds only interpreter/reached entries; outside bwrap is a parent-only tool.
Conditional ldconfig/cache capability is source-derived from Linux ctypes.util, not a claim Linux PyOpenGL uses its Windows find_library branch. No compiler/linker fallback is provisioned.
EGL/OpenGL dispatcher closure does not establish vendor JSON/driver discovery, contexts, devices or renderer qualification; no vendor/driver runtime is inferred.
Only trusted readelf parsed data; no ldd/targetinitializer/import/ELF execution/scientific/model/scene/catalog operation or CPU source/write occurred.
